gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
Much to everyone’s ___ (APPOINT), the open-air concert was cancelled.
gaps.explanation: 'To somebody’s disappointment' — the feeling noun follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: He's a regular ___ (CONTRIBUTE) to the magazine.

gaps.explanation: The subject is 'botany'; a specialist is a 'botanist'.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: There is no ___ (PROVE) that he was anywhere near the bank.
gaps.explanation: 'No proof that …' — the noun for evidence.
